entries.name: Caleb Williams
entries.summary: Head coach Ben Johnson said Monday that Williams (hamstring) will remain out for the Bears' Week 5 game against the Packers, Jason Lieser of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

entries.name: Jalen Coker
entries.summary: Coker (quadriceps) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Lions, Darin Gantt of the Panthers' official site reports.

entries.name: Jayden Daniels
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Jaylin Lane
entries.summary: Lane was diagnosed with a fracture and dislocation of his left ankle after undergoing tests Monday and is expected to miss the remainder of the season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Tylan Wallace
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Tyquan Thornton
entries.summary: Thornton is viewed as out indefinitely after dislocating his ankle during Sunday's 30-27 win over the Raiders, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Charbonnet (knee) won't be activated from the PUP list in advance of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.

entries.name: Marcus Mariota
entries.summary: Mariota has been diagnosed with an MCL sprain in his right knee after he was forced out of Sunday's loss to the Colts in London, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Pat Bryant
entries.summary: Bryant is expected to miss "a few weeks" after spraining his right ankle in Sunday's 24-14 loss to the 49ers, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Chris Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks is questionable to return to Sunday's Week 4 matchup against Tampa Bay due to an ankle injury, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: DJ Moore
entries.summary: Moore (shoulder) is dealing with an injury that isn't considered long-term, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Durham Smythe
entries.summary: Smythe (Achilles) won't return to Sunday's game against the Titans.

entries.name: Eli Raridon
entries.summary: Raridon (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against Buffalo.

entries.name: Hunter Long
entries.summary: Long (knee) is questionable to return against the Giants on Sunday.

entries.name: Ja'Marr Chase
entries.summary: Chase (concussion) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Jaguars.

entries.name: Jalen Nailor
entries.summary: Nailor (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's contest against the Chiefs.

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: Coach Ben Johnson said after Sunday's 23-12 win against the Jets that Monangai suffered a thumb injury during the contest, Kevin Fishbain of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Ladd McConkey
entries.summary: McConkey won't return to Sunday's contest at Seattle due to a foot injury.

entries.name: Lamar Jackson
entries.summary: Jackson (ankle) will undergo an MRI on Monday and is considered day-to-day after exiting Sunday's 24-18 win over the Titans, but the Ravens are hopeful he'll be ready to play Week 5 versus the Falcons, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Mack Hollins
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Vrabel said that he expects to know more about Hollins' calf injury later Monday, and the Patriots are uncertain if the wideout will be able to practice "for a couple days," Phil Perry of NBC Sports Boston reports.

entries.name: Noah Fant
entries.summary: Fant (abdomen) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Falcons, Matthew Paras of The New Orleans Times-Picayune reports.

entries.name: Rashee Rice
entries.summary: Rice (hamstring) is believed to have sustained a "relatively minor" injury in Sunday's win over the Raiders and could be ready to play following the Chiefs' Week 5 bye, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Saquon Barkley
entries.summary: Barkley will undergo further testing Monday, but the right hamstring injury he sustained in Sunday's 24-20 loss to the Rams isn't believed to be "overly serious," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Tank Bigsby
entries.summary: Bigsby left Sunday's game against the Rams late in the fourth quarter with an apparent lower-body injury and went into the Eagles' tent on the sideline, Jimmy Kempski of PhillyVoice.com reports.

entries.name: Tee Higgins
entries.summary: Higgins (adductor), per head coach Zac Taylor, is considered day-to-day, Ben Baby of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Brown was spotted Monday in the Patriots' locker room walking without a limp and wearing a small wrap on his injured right ankle, Taylor Kyles of CLNSMedia.com reports.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen reiterated Monday that Pierce didn't undergo surgery on his left heel and is continuing to rehab the injury, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Arian Smith
entries.summary: Smith (knee) underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn ACL and will miss the rest of the season, Antwan V. Staley of the New York Daily News reports.

entries.name: British Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Friday.

entries.name: Christian Kirk
entries.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Friday that the 49ers could open Kirk's (calf) practice window to return from injured reserve in two weeks, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: De'Von Achane
entries.summary: The Dolphins placed Achane (knee) on injured reserve Monday.

entries.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
entries.summary: Head coach Klint Kubiak said Friday that the hope is that Thornton (undisclosed) will be back at practice ahead of the Raiders' Week 5 road tilt against the Patriots, Levi Edwards of the Raiders' official site reports.

entries.name: Jack Bech
entries.summary: The Raiders placed Bech (forearm) on injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Jadarian Price
entries.summary: Price (chest) was placed on injured reserve Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Jalen McMillan
entries.summary: The Buccaneers placed McMillan (knee) on injured reserve Wednesday.

entries.name: Jaxson Dart
entries.summary: Dart recently underwent surgery to repair the meniscus and MCL in his left knee, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Jayden Reed
entries.summary: The Packers are expected to place Reed (neck) on injured reserve Wednesday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Jonah Coleman
entries.summary: Coleman (ankle) is being placed on injured reserve Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Jordyn Tyson
entries.summary: Tyson (hamstring) is said to be making progress and feeling good but isn't expected to be activated from injured reserve until Week 7 at the soonest, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Josh Oliver
entries.summary: The Vikings placed Oliver (biceps) on injured reserve Tuesday, Craig Peters of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Tank Dell
entries.summary: Head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that he expects the Texans to open Dell's (knee) 21-day practice window this week, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Ferguson (ankle) is out for Sunday's game against Philadelphia, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
entries.summary: The Saints are placing Etienne (hamstring) on injured reserve, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Xavier Legette
entries.summary: The Panthers placed Legette (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.
